_metadata.description: Synthetic rule fixture: a neutral donor (A/B) / treatment / concentration rule for 'explant FACS treatment & donor' experiments plus small neutral rules exercising the value_map, suffix, legacy-schema and alias features of the rule engine. Used by the batch-processing tests in place of any real project's rules.

rules.name: explant_facs_treatment_donor
rules.description: Explant FACS with donor (A/B) and treatment/dose conditions. File names look like 'L D_{date}_{donor}_{treatment}'.

rules.name: static_stain_treatment
rules.description: Neutral example: static staining experiments whose file names carry a treatment condition (e.g. 'Ctrl Living') and a concentration with a 'uM' suffix.

rules.name: neutral_experiment_id_example
rules.description: Neutral legacy-schema example: capture the leading experiment id token (e.g. the number after the letter prefix) from folder names like 'E42_...'.
